inputs.text: Bloomberg keeps pushing the idea that climbing energy prices, grounded flights, and endless scenes of chaos show the world demanding an immediate halt to the war against Iran, which they label a badly planned operation endangering global stability. Yet even they concede this view falls apart in Israel, where the public stands united behind their leaders to finish the fight to the end. This exposes the real strength of national resolve and authority over the feeble global hand-wringing. Israeli citizens back their leaders to complete the mission, defending their homeland, families, and way of life instead of yielding to progressive demands that promote weakness and disorder. That's the backbone of tradition and social order we must value and defend.
